fields.name: question
fields.note: The forecast question to answer about equities, earnings, or market movements.

fields.name: resolution_criteria
fields.note: Optional. The observable event that resolves the question (e.g. 'Q3 earnings report beats consensus EPS estimate').

fields.name: context
fields.note: Optional. Financial context: price history, analyst estimates, macro environment, recent filings.

fields.name: deadline
fields.note: Optional. Resolution date or time horizon.
